newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Elands, Deelkraal extend probe time.
newsitem.headline: Elands, Deelkraal extend probe time.

text.p: Elandsrand Gold Mining Co Ltd and Deelkraal Gold Mining Co Ltd said on Thursday they had extended the period of a due diligence investigation into a planned Elandsrand buyout of Deelkraal to May 7.
It urged shareholders to exercise caution in their share dealings until an announcement is made after the investigation.

Anglo American Corp of South Africa Ltd's Elandsrand said in March it would buy 100 percent of the share capital of Goldfields of South Africa Ltd's Deelkraal subject to a due diligence investigation and a fulfillment of a number of conditions precedent.
